verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe a 'Skills' feature ('Skills allow Copilot to perform specialized tasks') and 'Custom agents' that let developers tailor Copilot's expertise, plus MCP server extensibility to add custom tools/context. This directly matches the story of equipping the agent with custom skills, though details are thin. Missing for 10: concrete developer walkthrough of creating a skill, independent/hands-on confirmation of using custom skills, and richer documentation depth beyond a single-line description.
